## Frequent Asked Questions

  * How do I register to use the Library Management system?

Currently there is no online registration provided, please visit the library for registration. You are required to bring your passport size photo size 2 x 2 inches (51 mm), registration number and university identification card.

  * How many copies should am i allowed to borrow?

Only one book for 7 days (Loan Period) (inclusive weekends). CDs, DVDs and journals are issued for 3 days.

  * What happens if I return my books after the due date?

    1. Late returns: Tshs 2,000 per day.
    2. Late returns on recalled books (requested by another borrower): Tshs 5,000 per day

  * How do I know the due date?

Yo can log in to the library system and check the outstanding books, and thats where you can see your book due date. Kindly notye that you will need the username and password.

login here

  * How do I renew my loans?

You will be required to physically visit a library for renew. All items can be renewed except for the following:

    * Items that have been requested by another borrower
    * Items that are short term loan i.e. marked 24 hour
    * Items from the Reserve Collection
    * Items from Serials Collection i.e. journals, newspapers, government publications


  * What does library system search?

Library Management System  provides a single search for all items which are available in the library.

  * How should I find items on the shelf?

Location Symbols are the letters preceding the numbers on Library materials’ Shelf Numbers. These symbols stand for specific Shelf,  Collections, and sometimes the format of the material as well.

  * How do I access journals, journal articles and other e-resources when off-campus?

To access the online resources off the campus, you need to open library website/webpage under library resources open eResources (off campus) then login by your credentials.
